Fake Microsoft Teams (zen-recorder fixture)

Mimics the Teams web call flow as seen in Firefox: a pre-join screen with a camera preview and a microphone switch, a connecting screen, the lobby (media is connected there already: one mixed remote audio track, played by an <audio> under <body>), then the call screen with the toolbar and [data-stream-type] tiles. The microphone is sent through a clone of the getUserMedia track, and muting only disables that clone and swaps the toolbar icon. Add ?lobby=hold to stay in the lobby until "Admit" is clicked.
